text:
To Avery – Launch Update

Our launch was tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026.

Security review now completes October 12 at the earliest, and release needs completed approval. Nia owns the security review. The review may require remediation, and no new production date is authorized.

A staging demo can still happen October 8 using synthetic data. You choose whether to accept the staging demo.

I remain confident in the team to navigate this clearly.

Please confirm if you would like to proceed with the staging demo on October 8.

Best,
Jordan, engagement lead
